column1: # The A soft edge - A-measured bodies whose ONLY interior citation is a bare table row.
# A is measured, never declared: a function is A when a DOCUMENTED page cites an address
# strictly inside its body. I ruled the surface sound (1,030 of 1,446 carry two or more interior
# citations) with a named soft edge of 46 bodies - these - where the single citation is a row
# carrying nothing but an address and a mechanical name. THE RULING IS NOT REOPENED HERE; this
# writes the 46 down so the soft edge is inspectable instead of being a number in prose.
# `also_*` columns answer the question the A rule deliberately does not: an entry-only citation
# does not make a body A, but a body cited at its entry by a documented page, discussed across
# several documents, or carrying an AUTHORED name, is not an unexplained body - it is a body
# whose interior happens to be touched once. The bodies with none of those are the real edge.
# MEASURED AND THEN READ, 2026-09-14 (OPUS). Of these 46:
#     42  are ALSO cited at their ENTRY by a DOCUMENTED page. An entry citation does not make a body
#         A - that is the rule's whole point - but it does mean a documented page is discussing the
#         body, so a bare interior row is not the sum of what is known about it.
#     23  are mentioned by more than one document.
#      2  carry an AUTHORED name in the census rather than FUN_/LAB_.
#      4  have none of that: no entry citation, one document, a mechanical name. THEY ARE THE EDGE.
# SO THE SOFT EDGE OF THE A SURFACE IS 4 BODIES OF 1,446 - 0.28 % - not 46, and not 416.
# AND THE FOUR ARE ALL ONE TABLE ON ONE PAGE, which is worth stating exactly because it is not
# sloppiness. weather-terrain-element-scaling.md lists "every site that loads a 0.6f constant" -
# eight sites - to support a NEGATIVE: "Not one is in CombatFormula, and not one is the weather
# scaler." The Owner column reads `-` for the four precisely because they are NOT owned by the
# domain the page is about. The page is citing those functions to say THEY ARE NOT WHAT IT IS ABOUT,
# and the A rule counted them as individually explained for it.
# That is the gameability A was tightened to avoid, in its sharpest possible form: a page proving a
# negative makes four functions count as explained. It is 0.28 % of the surface and the ruling that
# A holds is unchanged - but it is a concrete case for
# OPUS-REQ-SWE2-AUDIT-SPEC-A-CITATION-BAR, which asks whether the citing row must say something.
# Here the row DOES say something, and what it says is the opposite of an explanation.
